row.text: Once upon a time, a little girl went to find a cave. She knew the cave was very far away and the path was difficult. She kept walking until she got to the cave. Once she arrived, she noticed something was attached to the cave. She looked closer and saw a pink flower! She thought it was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen. She decided to attach her own flower to the cave. She was very proud of her work. From that day forward, she wanted to go back to the cave every day. The cave became a special place to her.

Once there was a 3 year old boy named Jack. Every day, Jack liked to help his Mom in the kitchen. Today, Jack wanted to bake something special for his Mom for her birthday. 

In the kitchen, Jack found some flour and sugar and other ingredients he needed. He mixed them together in a big bowl. Then, he started to stir the mixture. He stirred it round and round until it was thick and creamy. 

After he was done stirring the mixture, Jack put it in the oven. He set the oven to the right temperature and waited for it to finish baking. 

When the baking was done, Jack could smell the delicious aroma coming from his cake. He carefully took Take it out of the oven, and saw that it was a perfect fit. He let it cool down.

Once it was finally cooled down, Jack added some decorations. He put a beautiful flower on the top of the cake. He also put some icing on the top and sides of the cake. 

Finally, Jack put the cake on a comfortable chair next to his Mom's bed. He put his heel right next to the cake so she could see it when she woke up! 

Jack was very proud of his special cake. He could not wait to see his Mom's reaction when she saw the cake.

Once there was a city full of people. Everyone was very selfish and didn't care about each other. Then one day, a funny little mouse came along. He was so fun and friendly that everyone in the city started smiling. Everyone was so happy that they clapped their hands and applauded the mouse. Everyone enjoyed spending time with him, too. Soon the whole city was no longer selfish, but full of love and friendship. All the people celebrated and applauded the little mouse in gratitude. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in a small town. One day, she went out to the park to play. As she skipped around, she spotted a red ball. With a squeal of delight, she ran towards the ball and began to bounce it.

"Look at me, Mommy! I'm bouncing the ball!" the little girl exclaimed. 

Her mom smiled. "Yes, you are! You look so happy!", she said.

The girl kept bouncing the ball until she got too tired. All of a sudden, she felt guilty. She had taken the ball without asking.

"Mommy, I'm sorry. I took the ball without asking," she said softly.

Her mom smiled. "It's okay, sweetheart. Let's take it back to the park tomorrow and let someone else have a turn," she said kindly.

The little girl smiled and hugged her mom. She felt much better now that she had taken responsibility for her actions. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to take responsibility and not to feel guilty when we make mistakes.

Once upon a time, there was a big ladder. Joe was ready to use it to go up to the top of his house. He wanted to paint the house. Joe started to pour the paint onto the ladder. He was so excited to start painting.

Suddenly the ladder started to move. Joe felt scared and held on tight. But the ladder was too slippery. Joe started to fall. He screamed and screamed but no one heard him.

He fell from the ladder and landed on the ground. It really hurt; Joe couldn't get up. His mom and dad ran outside. They were sad to see Joe on the floor. They took him to the hospital.

At the hospital, the doctor said Joe was not ready for a big ladder. Joe had to stay in bed for a long time. Even now, he still gets scared when he sees a ladder.

Once there was a girl named Piper. She was only 3 years old, but she loved tasks. No matter how small or big the task seemed, Piper was there to fill it. 

One day, Piper decided to go for a walk. She stopped to admire the flowers and saw a task no one had filled before. The task looked different from all the other tasks Piper had seen before. 

Piper bravely decided to fill the task, no matter the size or difficulty. But the task was too big for her to fill alone. So instead of trying to do it on her own, Piper asked her parents and friends to help. 

Soon, all the different tasks were finished. Piper's parents and friends were very proud of her. Together they had learned an important lesson: no task is too big when you ask for help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Suzie. She had big, blue eyes and loved to play with her toys.

One day, Suzie was playing in her garden when she saw a train rolling through the village. She marvelled at the bright, shiny carriage and wondered what it would be like to ride inside it.

The train was going very fast, but Suzie hoped she could one day go on a train too.

Until then, Suzie decided to imagine she was on the train. She pretended she was on a smooth journey with lots of surprises around every corner. She imagined she could be anywhere when the train came to a stop.

Suzie imagined she could go anywhere and do anything she wanted. She knew that her journey was just beginning, and she began to hope for the future.

Once upon a time, there was a lively little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her kite. Lily's kite was very special because it had brightly coloured streamers that would blow in the wind. 

One day, Lily took her kite to the park to have fun with it. But as she was getting ready to fly it, it suddenly flew away!

Lily was so sad. She ran to her mom and said, "Mommy, my kite flew away!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "It's okay, sweetheart. We can find the kite and go back to the park to fly it again."

So, Lily and her mom drove back to the park. When they got there, Lily's kite was still flying in the sky!

Lily's mom hugged her and said, "You forgive the kite for flying away and now it can forgive you for letting it go. That's why it stayed."

Lily was so happy! And from then on, whenever Lilly flew her kite, she always remembered to forgive it for occasionally flying away.

Carla picked up her cuddly toy bear. It was adorable. She loved to squeeze it tight and feel its soft fur against her skin. She was never without it! 

One day, Carla put the bear near the window. Then clouds appeared in the sky, and rain started to fall. Carla watched as steam rose up from the warm rain. 

Suddenly, a gust of wind blew the window open. The bear flew away! Carla tried to catch it, but it was lost. 
Carla was very sad. She had lost her most beloved and adorable friend.

Once there were two friends, Tom and Sam. Tom had a triangle and he was very happy. But then something bad happened.
Tom suffered a lot. He was so sad that he dropped his triangle. He started to cry and Sam felt terrible.

Sam wanted to make Tom feel better so he gave him a hug. Tom felt a little bit better. He remembered the triangle and remembered that it was bad. So he asked Sam what to do.

Sam knew the answer: He picked up the triangle and took it to the playground. There they found lots of toys and children who were playing happily. Tom and Sam went up to them. They asked the children if they wanted the triangle.

The children were so excited and quickly took the triangle. Then Sam turned to Tom and said, "Don't worry, Tom. You don't have to suffer anymore because of the bad triangle". Tom smiled and they all went to enjoy the playground.

Once upon a time, there was a safe elephant. His name was Elly.

Elly lived in a big forest with lots of other animals. One day, Elly saw a problem in the forest. Some trees were falling down. Elly wanted to help but he didn't know how. 

Then, Elly heard a voice. It was a friendly raccoon. He said, "Hi Elly! I have an idea to solve the problem."

Elly was excited. He said, "What is it?" 

The raccoon said, "Let's work together. With your long trunk, you can hold up the trees while I tie them together with string. That will make them stay safe."

Elly was so happy that he had found someone to help him solve the problem. He and the raccoon worked together and in no time, the trees were safe and strong. Elly was proud of his work.

Once there was a man called Steve who had a truck. He loved his truck very much. Everyday he would take it out and drive around the town.

One day, he had to load something very large and heavy. He was very troubled, because the truck had no sides! He didn't know how he was going to load this large item.

But then he had an idea! He bought some wood and built sides around the back part of his truck. Now he had a big space to load the large item.

He was so happy! After he loaded the item, he drove around town with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was an old man. He was really tired and wanted to rest. He looked for a soft and comfy spot to lay his head. He found an old iron fence and laid on it, but it was not very comfortable. He thought it was too bitter to rest there. Then, he found a big and fluffy pillow near the iron fence. He laid his head on it and fell asleep. He slept all night and by morning the pillow felt like a cloud! The old man was so happy and rested. He thanked the pillow and said goodbye. He went on his way feeling strong and full of energy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Amy. She was always curious and wanted to explore the world. One day, while exploring her garden, she stumbled across a little puppy. The puppy was so attractive and eager to play, so Amy decided to take the puppy home and protect it.

After a long time of playing and exploring together, Amy and the puppy had become best friends. Every day, they did all sorts of fun activities, like exploring the park and going on long walks. The two were so close that they even talked to each other.

One day, while they were walking, the puppy stopped and looked up at Amy. "Why do you protect me all the time?" the puppy asked.

Amy smiled and said, "Because I love you, and I want us to be friends for a long time."

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to play and have fun. One day, Sarah went to the park with her friends. They played tag and bounced on the trampoline for hours. Sarah laughed and had a great time!

After the playtime, Sarah and her friends went for a snack. Sarah felt so happy, she knew she had been a success. She was so proud of herself!

When afternoon came, Sarah was very tired. She had bounced, ran and laughed all day. Her mom came to pick her up and gave Sarah a big hug. She said that Sarah had worked very hard, and it was time to go home and rest. 

As they drove away, Sarah smiled - she had had a wonderful day. And she knew she would have the energy to bounce again tomorrow!

Once upon a time there was a kind farmer. He was always looking out for a helping hand. One day he loaded up his wagon and went to the market. He had a lot of goods and needed some help to get them all in. He looked around and then he saw a small boy. He asked the boy if he could help him. The boy said yes and they worked together to load up the wagon. The goods were heavy and it was a tight fit, but they managed to get it all loaded up. The farmer thanked the boy for helping him and gave him a few coins for his help. The boy thanked the farmer and ran off. From that day on, the farmer always knew he could count on a helping hand when he needed to load things up.

Once upon a time there was a big bear, called Doug. He loved to play outside, but one day he found something special in his garden. It was a big curtain! Doug wanted to play with it so he started to pull it. But when the curtain started to move, it made a lot of noise!

Doug was scared, he wanted to stop but he was so curious. And he kept pulling the curtain until it finally came off! Doug was so happy with his new toy, he couldn't wait to play with it.

Suddenly, Doug heard a loud growl and he was so shocked to see a big bear standing in front of him! The bear said: "You should be careful with things that don't belong to you. You should never take things without asking!"

Doug was so sorry, he knew he should have stopped earlier. He understood his mistake and promised to be more careful in the future. Doug and the bear became good friends from that day onwards. 

The moral of the story is: Always be respectful and ask for permission before taking anything that does not belong to you.

Jim was sad. He had been playing in the park all day and he was really tired. He sat down on the bench and started to complain. He said that the park was too dirty and he didn't like it.

Suddenly, a message floated down from the sky. It said "Hey Jim, why don't you come to the beach? It's clean and beautiful." Jim was excited and jumped up from the bench.

He ran all the way, but when he arrived at the beach, it was just as dirty as the park had been. Jim was even more angry than before and he started to complain again. He said "This beach is just as dirty as the park!"

But then he heard another message coming down from the sky. It said "Jim, just look around. There is so much beauty everywhere! See, there's a pretty tree, some birds and a nice big ocean. Everywhere you look there is love and beauty, you just have to see it!"

Jim looked around and he saw the beauty everywhere. He smiled and he knew that he had been wrong to complain about the dirty park and beach. From then on, he looked for beauty everywhere.

Once there was a small fish. It swam in the pond and had a lot of fun. The fish loved to splash and jump out of the water. One day, it saw a square on the surface of the water. It was gentle and it moved around gracefully. The fish was curious, so it jumped out of the water to take a closer look. 

When it got close to the square, the fish found out it was actually a big leaf. As the fish was swimming around the leaf, it splashed it with its fins and made it move around. The gentle leaf made waves in the pond and the fish had even more fun.

In the end, the little fish and the leaf became friends. They would splash and play around the pond together every day. It was the best game in the world!

"Look, mommy!" said Jerry as he gazed at the muffin in the bakery window. The muffin was a work of art - it was a swirl of different colors, and had a chocolate chip to top it off. Jerry was in awe.

"It's beautiful, isn't it?" said Mom. "Would you like to have one?"

Jerry nodded eagerly, and Mom bought him the muffin.

As he took his first bite, Jerry savored the sweet taste of the muffin. As he continued to gaze at it, he had an idea.

"Mommy," he said excitedly, "can we make creative muffins like this one at home?"

Mom smiled. "Yes, of course we can," she said. "We can make any kind of muffins you want!"

Jerry grinned, pleased that Mom was just as excited about making muffins as he was. He couldn't wait to get home and start making his imaginative creations.

A little girl named Mary was playing outside on a Tuesday. Her parents had warned her not to play with fire, but Mary was feeling brave and wanted to prove that she could be responsible.

Mary found a yellow stick and dragged it over to her campfire. She touched the stick to the fire and it began to burn. Mary was so excited she clapped her hands.

But then Mary's parents arrived. Mary felt ashamed and scared. She knew she had made a mistake.

Mary's father said, "Mary, fire can be very dangerous. We told you to be careful." He hugged her and said, "We love you, and we want you to stay safe. Remember, it's always good to be careful with fire."

Mary was very sorry and promised never to play with fire again. She learned that it's important to always listen to her parents and stay safe.

George was very excited. Today was his birthday and he knew he was going to receive a present. His mom took him to his room and opened the wide cabinet. Inside, George saw the biggest truck he had ever seen. It was blue with red wheels and it even had buttons to make noises. He was so excited he couldn't believe it.

He took the present and went outside to show his friends. They all cheered when they saw it and asked if they could have a turn and play with it. George said they could and they had so much fun playing with the truck.

Back inside, George said a big thank you to his mom and gave her a hug. She smiled and said it was all his gift. George was so happy that he received such a special present on his birthday.

Jack was a brave 3 year old boy who liked to explore. One day, while he was playing outside, he saw an old door. He had never seen it before. He walked slowly towards it, because he was curious. He grabbed the handle and tried to open it. It was locked! Jack tried harder and harder but could not unlock it. Just then, Jack saw a key on the ground. It was old and rough. He picked it up and put it in the door. He turned it, and the door unlocked. Inside he saw something very special. It was a big dinosaur! Jack was so excited. He petted it and the dinosaur snuggled up close. Jack smiled and they were best friends ever since.

Ducky was a little duck who had a very special secret. One day she went to the park with her mom. When she arrived, she saw a big square. It was so big that she had to jump to see the top of it!

Ducky started to poke the square with her tiny feet. Suddenly, a voice said, "Why are you poking my square?"

Ducky was worried. She didn't know where the voice had come from. But then she looked up and saw a tall bird standing on top of the square.

The bird said, "This square is my home. Please don't poke it."

Ducky said sorry and told the bird about her special secret. When the bird heard the secret, it smiled and said, "That's a wonderful secret. I won't tell anyone!"

Ducky was so happy that she hugged the bird. Then her mom called her to leave the park. Before leaving, Ducky waved goodbye to her new friend and the tall bird waved back.

Peter was a smart bunny who liked to go on adventures. One evening, he decided to explore in the garden. He marked the grass with pieces of string so he could find his way back. Peter hopped around, marking trees and flowers until he was so tired. He sat down under a tree and admired his work. The sun had already started to set in the sky. 

By now, Peter had marked the entire garden. He was so proud of himself, he hopped with joy around the garden. Suddenly, he heard the sound of his mother. It was almost nighttime and it was time to go back in. Peter gathered up the strings and hurried back to the house. 

Inside, Peter's mother had dinner ready. Peter was so excited to show off his markings from his adventure. His mother was so impressed by his smart idea that she gave him a hug. Peter wiped his paws and said goodbye to his garden for the evening. He ran inside for dinner, happy to be done exploring for the day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Bobby. He was so excited for the surprise birthday party his mom was preparing for him. He just couldn't wait to see what the surprise was going to be!

One day, Bobby decided to peek into the surprise. He opened the door and saw lots of presents! His eyes lit up as he saw all the wonderful gifts.

Disobeying his mom, Bobby couldn't help but take some of the rewards early. He stuffed the gifts into his pockets and ran away with his secret stash.

The next day, Bobby tried to uncover more of the birthday surprise but his mom caught him red-handed. She was very angry and told Bobby that bad things happen to people who don't listen. Bobby was sad, but he learned his lesson. No matter how tempting, it's important to obey mom!

The bald man sat in his chair, holding a journal. He was wearing a big, red hat and looked very serious. He read the journal for a long time. Suddenly, he began to cry. His cries were so loud that everyone in the room stopped what they were doing to look at him. 

The bald man kept reading the journal. He cried and cried until his face was all wet and his clothes were all wet too. No one knew what was wrong. Then, the bald man took a deep breath and said, "It's all been a terrible mistake, there's no way to fix it."

The bald man walked out of the room, never to return. Everyone was very worried. What had happened? What was in the journal? No one knew. They all just sat there, feeling sad and worried. 

The bad ending of the story was the bald man's strange behavior and words. What had been the mistake he had made? Would anyone ever find out?

Dave was an eager dancer. He loved to move around and do flips. Every day he practiced his moves. One day, he decided to try something new. He tasted a strange looking fruit. It had an odd taste, but he liked it. Suddenly, Dave felt sick. His head spun, and he dropped to the ground. The fruit was poisonous, and Dave couldn't get the help he needed. He lost feeling in his body and died shortly after. Dave's eager dancing came to a sad end.

Once upon a time there was a cute little girl. Every day she would love to play and sing her favorite song. Her song was so catchy! Every day she would repeat her song over and over again, until it was almost dark. 

One day, the little girl was walking around and singing her song when she met a big mean monster. He was so ugly and he growled at the little girl. He asked her to stop singing her song, but the little girl refused. 

The monster got very angry and he grabbed the little girl. She was so scared that she started to cry. But the monster didn't care, he just held the girl tightly and refused to let her go. 

The little girl never sang her song again. The monster kept her trapped and made sure that she never sang again. So the little girl never shared her cute song with the world again.  This is why you should always be careful who you meet when you are out and about in the world.

Once upon a time, there was a gray cat. One day, the cat wanted to give itself a name. So, it attached itself to a nearby tree to begin thinking.

The tree was tall and green, and the cat thought and thought. Eventually, it came up with the perfect name. The cat was so proud of its name that it did not want anyone else to know it.

The cat kept thinking and eventually attached its name to the tree. The cat felt so happy to have found a safe place for its name. 

But one day, a big storm hit the tree and the wind blew the name away. The cat searched everywhere but it couldn't find its name again. The cat was sad because it knew it could never find the perfect name again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She was three years old and she loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Jane asked her mom if she could go outside and play. Mom said yes and Jane went out with a big smile on her face.

As Jane was walking outside, she saw a big tire in the garden. She asked her dad, â€œWhat is this?â€ Dad said, â€œItâ€™s a tire. You can use it for fun!â€

Jane liked the tire, but it was dry. She asked her mom, â€œCan I put water on the tire?â€ Mom said, â€œSure, honey. That will make it fun for you!â€

So Jane filled up the tire with water and had a great time splashing and playing in it. She soon forgot all about the dry tire and just enjoyed playing in the cool water. 

Jane had such a great time with the tire that by the end of the day, she didnâ€™t want to leave!

Once upon a time there was a small jeep that lived in the forest. He was a very happy jeep, always rolling around and making friends with all the animals in the forest. One day, he noticed that a bee was in trouble. The bee was stuck in some thick mud and couldn't get out.

The jeep thought to himself, "I must help the bee!". He bravely rolled up right next to the bee and used all his strength to hold onto the poor bee. This gave the bee the strength to crawl out of the mud and fly away. The jeep was so proud to have helped his friend and felt really good inside.

That's when the jeep learned an important lesson. He knew that if he used his strength to help others, it would make him feel even better. From then on, the jeep was always helping the other animals in the forest, and they all appreciated his kind heart.

Once there was a naughty little boy who liked to play. He was very curious and he liked to explore. One day he was playing by the TV and he had a great idea. He wanted to store things in it! He brought his toys to the TV and put them inside. He was so proud of himself that he ran around, shouting about it. But then he realized something - he couldn't get them back out! He was stuck! His mama was so mad when she saw. She said, "That was naughty of you. You can't store things inside the TV!" The little boy was very embarrassed, but he knew his mama was right. He apologized and promised to never do it again.

Once, there was a man who had an expensive van. He drove it everywhere and never wanted to let it go.

One day, the man was driving it and he heard a noise. He stopped to take a look and he saw the engine was broken! He was very sad.

He couldn't afford to fix it so he threw the van away. Everyone was sad, but was happy that the van was gone.

The man decided that he no longer needed a van. And he promised himself he would never buy an expensive van again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Joe. He was only 3 years old and he loved to stay outside and play with his friends. One day, Joe wanted to climb up to the top of a big tree in the backyard. His mom said it was okay, so he started climbing. 

When he reached the top, he was so happy! But then he saw something wild! A large bird was sitting in the tree and it didn't look very friendly. Joe was scared, but he decided to stay and see what would happen. 

The bird said to Joe: "You should not stay here! It is too dangerous!" But Joe was scared, he didn't know what to do. Then the bird flew away very quickly, and Joe was left alone on the top of the tree. 

It got dark outside, and Joe started to cry. He wanted to get down, but he was too scared to move. He stayed up there, feeling cold and hungry, until the morning came. 

Joe's mom found him the next morning, still on the top of the tree. She was so worried, and thankfully Joe was safe, but he never went climbing again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was walking on the beach one day when she found a beautiful shell. She picked it up and was admiring it when suddenly a big wave came and washed the shell away.

Lucy was very sad and was about to cry, but then she heard a noise behind her. It was something big and it was coming closer! Lucy was scared.

She turned around and saw a dangerous-looking animal. She had never seen anything like it before. It had a big, sharp claw and it was snapping at her. Lucy was so scared that she ran away as fast as she could.

Luckily, she managed to get away from the dangerous animal. But from that day on, Lucy was careful when she went near the shell on the beach. She didn't want to get scared again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very intelligent. She went to the store with her mom and bought a new toy. The toy had lots of little nails in it, and the little girl wanted to remember where each nail went. She used her intelligent mind to remember where to place each nail and at the end of the day she finished her toy. She was so proud of her work! When her mom came home, the little girl showed her the finished toy, and her mom clapped with joy. The little girl was very proud of her accomplishment, and promised to always remember how intelligent she was.

Once upon a time, there was an attractive bird named Chirpie. Chirpie wanted to paint the biggest picture anyone had ever seen. Chirpie flew everywhere looking for the perfect color of ink. Finally, Chirpie found the ink, it was a nice, sparkly blue!

Chirpie flew back home, carrying the ink carefully in her beak. She worked all day and all night to get the picture just right. When it was done, she looked at it with delight.

Chirpie proudly hopped up on her perch and called out to her friends. "Come and see what I have made!" she cried.

The other birds flew to her perch and gasped in amazement. It was the most beautiful, colorful picture they had ever seen. Everyone clapped and applauded. 

"Well done, Chirpie," they said in unison.

Chirpie smiled, she had never felt so proud. It was just the beginning of her journey as an artist and she knew there would be more beautiful works of art to come.

In the park, there was a big slide. Jack's eyes lit up as he ran up to it, looking handsome in his cute blue trousers and yellow shirt.

"Mommy, look!" he exclaimed.

Jack's mother smiled. "Wow, Jack, it looks so much fun!"

The two of them raced up the steps together, and Jack reached the top first. He looked around eagerly.

"Go, Jack!" his Mommy said with a laugh.

Jack took a deep breath and then pushed off. He slid all the way to the bottom, whooping with delight.

Mommy met him with a melon slice.

"Here you go, sweetheart," she said, handing it to him. "You look so cute!"

Jack smiled as he took a bite of the juicy melon. 

Then, he ran back to the top of the slide, ready to do it all over again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named May. She was a brave, adventurous soul and loved exploring. She had heard stories of a sailor who lived in a small boat on the nearby lake.

So one day, May asked her parents if she could go find the sailor. At first, her parents were unsure and did not allow her to go. But she was persuasive, so they eventually agreed but warned her to be careful.

May excitedly walked to the lake and found the sailor. He was wearing a big coat because it was cold. The sailor welcomed May and let her get into his boat. He told her about his adventures and let her use the oar to try and make the boat sail. Together, May and the sailor sailed around the lake for hours until it got dark.

The sailor sent May home and waved goodbye as she left. May had a wonderful day and thanked her parents for allowing her to go.

Once upon a time there was a girl, who was brave and strong. She wanted to make a perfect dress, with lots of colourful stitches. But she faced a problem, the dress kept falling apart no matter how many stitches she added. She kept trying to fix it, but it kept coming apart.

But then, one day, the girl had an idea. She took a tiny needle and thread and worked on the dress, carefully and slowly making small, tight stitches. The dress stayed together, no matter how hard she pulled it. The girl was so happy, as her hard work had finally paid off â€“ the dress was now perfect!

The girl knew she had to keep working on the dress, to make sure it stayed strong and perfect. But, no matter how hard she worked, the dress stayed together and resisted coming apart. The girl was so proud of her perfect dress. She knew she had used the perfect stitches.

Once there was a frog. He loved to sing. He opened his mouth wide every day and sang a green song. Everyone around him would stop and listen.

One morning he woke up feeling extra sleepy. He tried to sing his green song, but all he could do was yawn. He stretched out his arms, but the yawns kept coming!

He gave up trying to sing and instead decided to take a nap. He found a nice spot in the sun and yawned himself to sleep.

When he woke up, he felt much better. He opened his mouth wide and sang his green song with all his heart. Everyone around him was smiling as they sang along. 

It was a special moment - one that he would never forget. And he never yawned while singing his green song ever again!

Once there was a little girl and her name was Lisa. She had a modest home full of love and her daddy was always there to make her smile. Every day he would take her for a walk and sing her a song. She loved it! 

One day, Lisa asked her daddy to repeat the song for her. He said yes and sang it over and over again until he got tired. Lisa giggled and thanked her daddy for singing it so many times. She felt so special when he showed her all of his love. 

Every day since then, Lisa asked her daddy to repeat the song and he always said yes. He loved her so much and she loved him too. Together they were the happiest they could be.

Once upon a time, there was a brave pink rabbit called Bob. Bob was a gentle creature and he spent most of his days observing the world around him. One day, Bob had a funny urge to try something crazy. He felt something was telling him to do something wild, like hopping up to the sun! Bob thought this was a silly thought and dismissed it.

But then something strange happened. As Bob continued to observe, he noticed a cloud up in the sky slowly moving directly over the sun. Perhaps this was Bobâ€™s sign? He took a deep breath and decided that he should try something he never did before.

So Bob hopped as hard as he could and jumped right on top of the cloud. He was shocked! He was so high up! For a moment, Bob felt like he could touch the sun. After a while, Bob started to feel scared and had to quickly make his way back down.

Once he was back in his little home, Bob learnt an important lesson. He didnâ€™t have to do something wild and crazy to have an exciting adventure. He could just observe and appreciate the world around him. Bob was satisfied that he had learnt a valuable lesson and happily hopped off to bed.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was only three years old and very excited. She went to her bedroom to sort her toys. She found all kinds of fun things, including a pink poem. Lucy was so happy to have this poem and read it out loud.

"This poem has the power to make me happy!" she exclaimed.

But suddenly, a large monster came in and snatched the poem away from her. He wouldn't give it back and roared in a very deep voice.

"Give it back!" shouted Lucy.

But the monster refused and ran away with the poem. Lucy was devastated and started crying. There was nothing else she could do. She had lost her pink poem and would never have it again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Ellie who was 3 years old. 
One day, Ellie was feeling chilly and cold so she decided to find something to keep her warm. She searched all around the house but couldn't find anything.

Suddenly Ellie had a super idea. She remembered seeing a blanket in the wardrobe a few days ago, so she opened it and grabbed it. She wrapped the blanket around her and felt its warmth. It was hot!

Ellie had solved her problem and she was very happy. She felt warm and cozy and had a big smile on her face.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted to go to the store. She was so excited! When she arrived at the store, she ordered a treat. The store had lots of different things but she decided on something icy. It was so cold and yummy! She ate it all up and then decided to get one for her mom. She ordered another icy treat for her mom and then went home. Her mom was very happy to get her special icy treat. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Max. She had an incredible pole that she liked to use to adventure with. Every day, Max would borrow her pole and go on a new adventure in the woods. 

One day, while Max was exploring, she noticed something strange. Someone had borrowed her pole and was not bringing it back! Max was very upset and did not know what to do. 

The next day, Max decided to follow the clues she had noticed to find out who had borrowed her pole. She followed the clues until they led to a mysterious old house.

Max bravely knocked on the door. To her surprise, an incredible shape-shifting dragon answered. It seemed to be using Max's pole to fly around!

Max politely asked the dragon to return her pole. The dragon was so surprised by Max's courage that it decided to give it back. Max was so relieved and thanked the dragon for returning her pole. 

Max learned an important lesson that day; it pays to be brave!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jody. She was three-years-old and very curious. Jody was playing in the living room, and noticed something very interesting. On the shelf, there was something that was very clean. She walked closer and noticed it was a sparkly toy. She stopped and paused for a moment. Then she reached up and carefully took it off the shelf. Jody looked at the toy with excitement, and could not believe her luck. She ran off into the next room and started playing. She smiled at the toy and knew that it would be her new best friend.

Alice was a 3 year old girl who lived in a small house with her mom. Every day she would put on her shoes and go with mom to the park.

Alice always had a lot of fun at the park. She would often find something different, like the soap bubbles her mom made with her hands.

"Look at the bubbles mom!" said Alice.

Her mom smiled. "It's amazing what soap can do! It can make all sorts of different things, like bubbles or a beautiful painting."

Alice looked around the park. She imagined what was possible with soap. "I think I can make a big castle," she said.

Her mom gave her a hug. "I'll support you. Let's go get some soap and have some fun."

Alice smiled. She was excited to see what she could create with soap. The day was full of surprises.

Mummy had a big jar of jam. It was big and messy. Little Jack wanted the jam. He asked mum, she said no but he didn't listen. He tried to carry the jam to his bedroom but he was too little and he dropped it. The jam went everywhere. It was a big, messy mess! 

Mummy was very mad. She said no more jam for Jack. Jack was very sad, but he understood why mummy was mad. 

So mummy cleaned up the mess and gave Jack a big hug. She said if Jack ever wanted jam again he had to ask first. Jack said he would never try to carry the jam on his own again.

One day, two boys decided to race each other. They were so excited that they did it over and over again. One boy wanted to win so badly that he used a powerful word to make himself go faster. That word was "magic".

Suddenly, the other boy began to go faster and won the race. He was very happy and the other boy was sad. He had used his powerful word and that was not fair.

The boy who had lost was so angry that he said the powerful word once more. But this time, something strange happened. He started to fly up into the sky! He was so high that he couldn't come back down.

The boy was stuck in the sky and the other boy was very upset. He didnâ€™t know what to do. Unfortunately, this was a bad ending and the boy was never able to come back down.

Marc was a young boy who was always looking for fun. One day, he saw a girl playing by herself and he thought it would be nice to join her. He asked her if he could play with her and she said yes. 

They started talking and Marc quickly realized how boring the girl was. He told her he valued her, but he didn't really mean it. 

The girl noticed that Marc wasn't really listening to her, so she asked him what he valued. Marc was too impatient to really explain it properly and said, 'I value things that are interesting'. 

The girl felt hurt and ran away crying. Marc tried to apologize, but it was too late. He realized it was his own fault for not valuing her properly and he felt sad because he had hurt the girl's feelings. Unfortunately, it was too late to fix the situation and Marc was left with a dull and boring day.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who lived far away. She was so far that no one knew where she was.

One day, a brave boy wanted to find the princess. He looked and looked, up high and down low. Finally, he saw something far away. Could it be the princess?

The boy ran as fast as he could until he caught up to her. He was so happy!

They ran around, playing and laughing together. They even sang a song. Eventually, it was time for the boy to go home. But before he left, the princess gave him a big hug and said goodbye.

The boy had caught the princess! He was so excited. He held on to the hug from the princess, and walked back home with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved summer. He loved to go outside and play in the sun, and he never wanted it to get dark.

One day, he found a baby bird who was all alone. He wanted to help it, so he decided to feed it. He found some worms for it to eat and he felt happy he was helping.

But then it started to get dark and the little boy wanted to go home and eat dinner. He was feeling guilty because he wanted to leave the little bird, so he found some more worms and left them for the bird.

The next morning, the little boy was happy to see the bird was still there and he fed it breakfast. He had helped the bird survive summer!

Once there was an ugly sack. It was a big, brown sack, and it was so old that it was starting to rip. It wanted to be stylish just like all of the other sacks, but it was too ugly.

So, the sack decided to go on an adventure. It traveled all around, trying to find its style. Everywhere it went, it only found more ugly sacks, nothing that could make it look special.

The sack kept going until it arrived at a big river. It stopped to rest in the sun, when it saw the most beautiful sack it had ever seen! This sack was colored with bright oranges, purples, and blues, and it was sparkling in the sunlight.

The ugly sack knew the other sack was its style. So it asked the other sack to teach it how to be beautiful. The other sack said yes and started to teach the ugly sack all its secrets. Soon, the ugly sack was looking just like the other sack, and it felt so wonderful! 

Now the two sacks travel together, and they can be found walking around the big river. They love showing off their new style and always look so amazing!

Once there was a little boy who wanted to travel. He enjoyed the peaceful days and wanted to find more. So he packed his bag, kissed his mom goodbye and set off on his way.

He traversed the land for many days and many nights. He discovered different places and even stumbled into a peaceful village. All of the villagers were so friendly and helped him on his journey.

Then one day he came to a large river and noticed a strange wrecked boat in the distance. He decided to cross the river in the boat and he waved goodbye to the villagers. His journey continued until the river became too strong. He was pulled into the raging waters and all he could hear were the villagers shouts for help.

But he slowly sank into the deep and dark water. He never made it to his destination, and the last thing he remembered was the peaceful river.

Once upon a time, there was a cabin in the woods. It was a very old cabin, but Jack liked it. He was a little boy who lived alone in the cabin with his puppy.

One day, Jack was very confused; he could smell something strange. It wasn't his puppy's food, it was something else. So, he followed his nose and went to the back of the cabin.

When Jack got to the back of the cabin, he saw smoke! The cabin had caught fire. It was burning so fast; he couldn't do anything to put it out.

Jack tried to run into the cabin, but it was already too late. He shouted out to his puppy, but it was too scared to come out. He cried, "My puppy's still inside! Help me!"

But no one came. Jack was alone, confused and scared. His cabin burned to the ground until nothing remained. Jack and his puppy were both gone forever.

Tommy was playing in his room when his friend Sarah came to visit. Sarah was always so noisy and loud. Tommy asked, "Why are you so noisy?"

Sarah just laughed and said, "I am excited to see you!"

"Oh," said Tommy, not sure what to do.

Sarah said, "Let's go to bed now. We can sleep in my bed together."

Tommy was so happy to have a friend to sleep with, so he said, "Yes, let's go!"

The two friends had a wonderful time sleeping in Sarah's bed until morning. Tommy was so happy that he had a new and noisy friend like Sarah.
